static_traits.name: Li An
static_traits.social_status: Relationship with Mother is tense due to marriage topics; has one close friend to confide in; feels expected and judged at Family gatherings
static_traits.medical_history: No history of similar psychological problems; never received psychotherapy; no significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Able to actively express the subjective experience of 'guilt and pressure'; willing to try recording thoughts but Skeptical attitude toward change; clear logic; speech rate Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: Guilt and pressure around being Unmarried and childless, often intensifying at Family gatherings or when friends discuss family, assuming Mother is disappointed in oneself, leading to Anxiety, Decreased attention, and insomnia.
basic_info.core_demands: Because the guilt and pressure surrounding marital status have already affected mental health and daily functioning, she seeks counseling to lessen these negative effects.

core_beliefs: I have not met my family's expectations
I am falling behind my peers

special_situations.event: Being asked about marriage and children at Family gatherings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am Unmarried and childless, it means I am not good enough and will disappoint my family.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to ignore thoughts about marriage and puts attention on work.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are judging me, Mother must be very disappointed.

special_situations.event: Friends discuss their partners and children in social settings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I have not started a family and career like my peers, it means I am behind and worse than them.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces expression and participation in such topics and turns attention to work instead.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am worse than others, I have fallen behind.

special_situations.event: Sensing unspoken expectations when visiting Mother
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: I should marry and have children as soon as possible to meet the standard and not disappoint Mother.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding in-depth discussions of marriage and dating with Mother to reduce the pressure of expectations.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I should hurry up and get married and have children.

special_situations.event: Worrying about the future when approaching an age milestone (nearly 30)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: As one ages, if still unmarried and childless, things will only get worse.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying to ignore Anxiety and throw oneself into Work, but struggling to stay focused.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Time is running out, the future will only be worse.

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized by Mother and family, accepted unconditionally
core_conflict.fear: Fears being judged and seen as a failure, thus becoming distant from significant others
defense_goal: Lowering Anxiety through Repression and avoiding marriage-and-dating topics, maintaining superficial harmony and a sense of safety

object_relations.self_representation: One who is expected of but falls short, a 'disappointer of Mother'
object_relations.object_representation: Mother with implicit criticism and strong expectations

object_relations.self_representation: The 'one who lags behind', at a disadvantage in group comparisons
object_relations.object_representation: The 'social others or peers' who judge individuals by the standard of establishing a family and career

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: At Family gatherings or when asked about marriage and children
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Others (especially Mother) are judging oneself as failing, seeing oneself as a failure (transference: projecting one's experience of shame onto others' judgment)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Respond politely and briefly, quickly shifting the topic to Work or daily life, avoiding emotional depth and detail exposure.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking with friends about romance or thinking of scenes with friends and children
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: They will look down on me, thinking I am not good enough (transference: attributing Self-denial to others' views)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Use vague and evasive statements, reduce self-disclosure, ending the topic on grounds of time or errands when necessary.

manifestations: Feeling Restricted choices under social/family expectations about marriage and childbearing
Worries about being judged after expressing real thoughts, thus avoiding discussing marriage and dating topics
outcomes: Self-doubt and a sense of pressure

manifestations: Experiencing the difference between self and others while Unmarried and childless
Hard to discuss this topic deeply with others, worrying about being looked down on
outcomes: Avoiding sharing leads to insufficient sense of support

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Uses 'should' as a self-standard (believing oneself should marry and have children as soon as possible)
Internalizes society's and family's expectations about marriage and childbearing as the core basis of self-evaluation

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Believing Mother and others will look down on oneself or be disappointed (mind-reading judgment)
In socializing, presetting others' negative evaluations and thus reducing expression

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Careful with words and actions for fear of being judged
Unwilling to discuss inner experiences in depth, fearing being seen as a failure

positive_force: Overall work performance stable, with professional dedication
Holding a Master's degree in education, with cognitive and Reflection abilities
Has one close friend who can provide emotional support
Willing to try recording and observing automatic thoughts (has willingness to change)
negative_force: Excessively seeks external evaluation and recognition (External Validation)
Mind reading and jumping to conclusions lead to negative Anticipation of others (Mind Reading/Jumping to Conclusions)
Social comparison triggers inferiority (Comparing and Despairing)
Sleep disturbed and Decreased attention maintain the pressure cycle

target_behavior.behavior: Significant anxiety and guilt arise when marriage and childbearing topics come up, along with Avoiding deep communication
antecedent: Being asked about marriage and children at Family gatherings
Sensing unspoken expectations when visiting Mother
Approaching age milestones triggers self-comparison and worry
target_behavior.core_reason: Introjecting society's and family's expectations about marriage and childbearing as self-evaluation standards, with cognitive biases such as mind reading, overgeneralization, and comparative despair.
target_behavior.function: Avoids being judged and negative emotions, maintaining surface safety and interpersonal harmony.
target_behavior.consequence: Sleep affected (occasional insomnia), Decreased work focus, Relationship tension with Mother, Persistent anxiety and Self-denial.
